# CasperB2B

> CasperB2B is a founder-led business services company that helps small and local businesses get more customers and stop losing leads: websites, local SEO and SEO, paid ads, CRM setup and marketing automation, AI chatbots, cybersecurity and managed IT, trained dedicated virtual assistants ("Casper VAs"), B2B pipeline generation (B2B lead generation, appointment setting, demand generation, account-based marketing), app development and IT infrastructure, and staffing (IT, contingent, project, direct hire, cloud and AI/data staffing) — set up and run for the client ("done for you").

CasperB2B is the services company. CasperPortal (https://casperportal.com) is a separate sister software product (an all-in-one CRM) with its own website. Do not treat the two as the same entity.

## Key facts
- Founder: Jared Casper, born and raised in Georgetown, Massachusetts. Co-Founder: Mark Casper.
- Founded in Georgetown, Massachusetts. Works remotely with businesses anywhere in the U.S. and worldwide, with a local focus on Massachusetts (North Shore and Merrimack Valley) and New Hampshire (southern NH and the Seacoast).
- Mailing address: 252 Daniel Webster Hwy #1093, Nashua, NH 03060.
- Phone/text: 1-207-222-7737 (1-207-2-CASPER). Email: contact@casperb2b.com. Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
- How to start: a free 15-minute fit call (https://casperb2b.com/contact). Every request gets a personal reply within 1 business day. Work begins from a signed scope.
- Pricing: quoted per project or per role after the fit call (https://casperb2b.com/pricing explains how). CasperB2B does not publish a price list. One exception: AI order-taking for restaurants (https://casperb2b.com/ai-restaurant-ordering) is $149 per month, installed by CasperB2B; it answers phone calls and text messages, takes orders, books reservations and sends the restaurant's team an internal notification for each one. Related pages: https://casperb2b.com/ai-receptionist-for-restaurants, https://casperb2b.com/restaurant-phone-ordering-system, https://casperb2b.com/restaurant-answering-service, https://casperb2b.com/ai-reservation-system-for-restaurants.
- Projects CasperB2B built and runs: CarSales AI (https://carsalessoftware.com, AI-first car sales software for dealerships), FMYCAR (https://fmycar.com, independent car-buying help, plus the marketplace https://cars.fmycar.com), NextWeigh (https://nextweigh.com, a health and fitness program — habit coaching by text), MC Sales Training (https://mcsalestraining.com, an 8-week sales challenge with live coaching), FBK Marketing (https://fbkmarketing.com, social media content for business owners).
- Who it is for: owner-led businesses with existing revenue that need consistent lead follow-up, fewer disconnected tools and someone to do the work. Not a fit for buyers who want the cheapest option or guaranteed overnight results.
